response.rationale: For the narrowed sense of switching off a light, Indonesian mematikan and Malaysian memadamkan are ordinary, useful variety preferences. Memadamkan is less natural for switching off a general device, so the cue is narrowed.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian usage may also use mematikan lampu, weakening the national contrast for some learners.
